name: Hivevowed Sanctus

Traits.name: Aura of Authority
Traits.text: While in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the sanctus, the sanctus and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the sanctus doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The sanctus makes three attacks, using Plague Sting or Choking Slam in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Hive Mandate.

Actions.name: Plague Sting
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. 18 (3d8 + 5) Piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) Poison damage.

Actions.name: Choking Slam
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. 29 (7d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

Actions.name: Hive Mandate
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

lore: A lesser servitor of the celestial order of plagues, it believes filth is a mercy, cleansing the living of their corrupt flesh by filling them with its holy flies one town at a time.

generation.userConcept: a plague-bearing archon of flies that commands lesser swarms

monsterDescription: a plague-bearing archon of flies that commands lesser swarms
